description: Advances: specled.package. From the specled_-xde verifier (2026-07-26, epic specled_-0x4): skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/adoption-phases.md:38 states the phase criterion 'mix spec.check exits 0 with no findings beyond detector_unavailable'. Applying that criterion requires seeing info-level findings, which bare mix spec.check hides — the adopter sees only 'info hidden; --verbose to show'. It is a criterion rather than a probe instruction (weaker than the four N2 sites xde fixed) but the same trap. Add --verbose (or the SPECLED_SHOW_INFO=1 form) to that line, matching the style specled_-xde used at the four probe sites.
title: Bootstrap skill: adoption-phases.md phase0 done-criterion needs --verbose for detector_unavailable visibility
